name: Prisma

repo.name: prisma
repo.description: Next-generation ORM for Node.js & TypeScript | PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB and CockroachDB

node_fit.hypothesis: Prisma can support typed schema access and migrations for JS/TS node systems.

evidence.note: Repository metadata shows active pushes, Apache-2.0 license, broad DB support, and recent 7.8.0 release.

risks: Prisma is an adapter/ORM, not a database substrate.
Generated client and migration workflows need careful testing in agent-built projects.
Best fit is JS/TS stacks, not every node runtime.
next_review_tasks: Test Prisma with SQLite node artifact schema.
Document migration workflow for agent-generated schema changes.
Compare with direct SQL and other lightweight schema adapters.
